data.body: Perf blocker fixed: referencing_commits builds an alias index once (single store pass) instead of O(distinct_aliases x store) scans. New _ids.build_alias_index/_effective_alias_for_dir + optional alias_index on resolve_ticket_id; threaded through commit_impact.referencing_commits; re-exported from resolver. RED perf test (7 scans -> 1). lint+typecheck green; 809 related tests pass. 4.6s vs 70+min on real 5300+ ticket store. Bug 4234-821b (unhygenic-reversible-mare) created/claimed/linked discovered_from REB-3233. Pushed Gerrit change 2159, awaiting LLM-Review+1 and Verified+1.
